faq.q: What is Vice City Police Department in GTA 6?
faq.a: Vice City Police Department is a police listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Vice City Police Department confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Vice City Police Department as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Vice City Police Department?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Business type: police. Listed locations: Vice City, Vice-Dale County, Leonida. Associated vehicles: Vehicles. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Vice City Police Department information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Vice City Police Department, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Vice City Police Department?
faq.a: Most of it. Vice City Police Department rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Whether the player can enter it and whether it can be robbed or bought are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Vice City Police Department be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of business entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
